decisions.reason: As a simple accessory with low carrying cost and a clear fit with the firm’s trailer business, it remains a cheap option to keep while demand information is still limited.
A box car trailer series sits close to the firm’s core offer and was prominent on the home page, so the firm is likely to preserve this option for another year despite early uncertainty.
The car transporter trailer is a more specialized line with somewhat higher complexity and narrower demand, but after only about a year the uncertainty is not yet resolved enough to justify exit.
The low-bed trailer series is adjacent to the established hauling portfolio and visibly promoted, making it worth keeping unless clearer evidence of weak value emerges.
A high trailer cover series likely has relatively low incremental cost and complements existing trailers, so its option value is high compared with its carrying cost.

Because this is another box car trailer series, overlap raises the chance of later portfolio rationalization, but the firm would still usually wait longer before dropping a newly launched core-category line.
